question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a yellow ball, Bob has a purple ball, Claire has a green ball, Dave has a blue ball, Eve has a black ball, Fred has a grey ball, and Gertrude has a orange ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Fred and Bob swap balls. Then, Claire and Dave swap balls. Then, Alice and Claire swap balls. Then, Eve and Bob swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Claire swap balls. Then, Dave and Gertrude swap balls. Finally, Fred and Dave swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) yellow ball
(B) purple ball
(C) green ball
(D) blue ball
(E) black ball
(F) grey ball
(G) orange ball
solution:
Ball colors in order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude
Initial: yellow | purple | green | blue | black | grey | orange
1. Fred–Bob: yellow | grey | green | blue | black | purple | orange
2. Claire–Dave: yellow | grey | blue | green | black | purple | orange
3. Alice–Claire: blue | grey | yellow | green | black | purple | orange
4. Eve–Bob: blue | black | yellow | green | grey | purple | orange
5. Gertrude–Claire: blue | black | orange | green | grey | purple | yellow
6. Dave–Gertrude: blue | black | orange | yellow | grey | purple | green
7. Fred–Dave: blue | black | orange | purple | grey | yellow | green
Alice has the blue ball, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
